detail.headline: A brand people recognise and remember
detail.intro: Your brand is more than a logo. It is the colours, fonts, tone and feeling people connect with your business. We build a clear identity so you look the same everywhere, from your shop board to your Instagram page.

benefits.title: Build trust

benefits.title: Save time
benefits.text: Brand guidelines mean every future poster, post or page is quick to make.

benefits.text: We design an identity that still works as your business expands.

about.title: One team for your whole brand
about.lead: REDFOX is an advertising and marketing online. We design the brand, build the website, shoot the photos and run the campaigns, so everything looks and sounds like one business.
story: A business should not need five different agencies to look good and get found. That one idea is how REDFOX works.
Our designers, developers, photographers and marketers sit in one team, so your logo, website, photos and campaigns match from the first draft.
Every project starts with a plan, a timeline and a quote. You see concepts before anything goes live, and we keep improving the work after launch.
